connector.name: Geo by thinair.co
connector.registryDescription: Geocoding, truck routing, traffic, weather, and place search via MCP - 11 hosted tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at geo.thinair.co over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace co.thinair, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Paste `Bearer ta_live_...` (or `Bearer ta_trial_...`). Get a free key — 15 req/day, no card — at https://geo.thinair.co/connect.
